text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> service="model-catalog" severity=high — symptom=tokenizer mismatch errors spiking on /embed endpoints
pd-bot: Created PD incident INC-9017; routed to eng-oncall -> mira

mira: acked. I'm on it. @alex can you pull promotion events and recent catalog commits?

alex: pulling logs now. I see an autopromote executed at 03:05 UTC that set redwood-embed-2 default -> rev=2025-04-02T03 (author=svc-autopromote). Diff includes tokenizer metadata changed from hf-bpe-1 -> hf-bpe-compat-2
sam: runtime reports tokenization parse errors (tokenizer-mismatch) causing downstream embedding transform to return 502. Error sample: `TokenizerError: unknown token mapping at offset 12`

leila: telemetry — 5xx on /v1/embed up 18% in last 8m. Top impacted tenants: NimbusAI (high), HealthQ (medium). Fallbacks are increasing CPU due to re-tokenization attempts.
mira: blocking autopromote for that namespace. Sam, prepare rollback steps. Alex, confirm the previous revision is healthy and pinned version id.
alex: previous default revision = 2024-12-15T19 and passes smoke tests. I'll validate checksums and metadata now.
sam: planned rollback command:

```
# revert default revision for model
catalogctl promote --model redwood-embed-2 --revision 2024-12-15T19 --note "rollback tokenizer mismatch"
```

leila: also creating a temporary traffic-split rule to route new requests to stable variant: `routectl set-split redwood-embed-2 100:2024-12-15T19`

mira: do the revert first, then routing rule. Jordan, can you notify the account managers for NimbusAI & HealthQ with a short heads-up? Wording: "potential impact to embed endpoints; mitigation in progress".
jordan: pinging CS/AMs now. I'll include links to known workarounds (retry with older model id)

ops-bot: Audit event: autopromote by svc-autopromote at 03:05 UTC; change id=catalog-change-9a3f logged.

sam: running revert now — executing catalogctl promote ...
sam: confirmed success, catalogctl returned 200 and new default shows 2024-12-15T19

alex: verifying runtime pickup. Watchers: tokenizer-mismatch logs dropping. Rolling 5m error rate from 18% -> 3.2% in ~4 minutes.

mira: good. Leave the temporary split in place until we validate for 30m. Also open ticket to block autopromote when tokenizer metadata key is present and differs from existing family.
alex: creating INF-4245: "autopromote: fail if tokenizer metadata incompatible with family defaults" and assigning to eng-platform + eng-ml.

jordan: AMs updated. NimbusAI applied temporary retry on their side; HealthQ acknowledged and wants postmortem.

leila: ran a quick audit across last 48h — found one other autopromote but tokenizer metadata identical; only redwood-embed-2 had a tokenizer variant change.
mira: ok. PD: set incident state to monitoring; require 30m stable window before resolve.
pd-bot: Annotated INC-9017 — mitigations applied (rollback + routing split). Monitoring window started.

sam: leaving a runbook note under /docs/incidents/INC-9017 with commands and timeline. I'll add exact log excerpts and the command outputs.

incident-bot: status update: monitoring — next auto-check in 10m
mira: handing off 3h watch to alex while I work on the CI guard. Alex you own the postmortem and follow-ups.
alex: taking handoff. I'll monitor metrics and draft RCA.

jordan: prepping a customer-facing blurb + ETA for RCA (target EOD).

leila: final check: error rates steady at ~2.8% and trending down. No new tokenizer mismatch traces in last 12 minutes.
mira: good. After 30m stable and no regressions, we can close. Follow-ups: 1) INF-4245 autopromote guard, 2) add a smoke test step that runs tokenization verification post-promo, 3) improve promo audit alerts when tokenizer metadata changes.

alex: noted. Also will add a short script to verify tokenizer name parity before autopromote.

pd-bot: INC-9017 — monitoring period complete; ready for resolution if no new errors in next 30m.

mira: resolving on my side after final check. Great quick mitigation, team. :clap:

alex: post-incident notes to include root cause = autopromote allowed a revision with a tokenizer variant that wasn't compatible with existing serving code/transform; mitigation = rollback + temporary split; follow-ups = INF-4245, smoke-test, better alerts.

incident-bot: incident closed by mira at 03:46 UTC. Postmortem to be published to /docs/incidents/INC-9017-pm.md within 72h.
